tips: | Phoenix ruins your day, basically un-killable through Turtle and Bear stance. Try to kite him in fights and stay away from his storm.
| Really annoying with saplings and CC. However, you can W his ultimate.
| If she gets ahead, she can burst you instantly until you have Maw. However, you beat her early and when you're even.
| If she gets ahead, she can burst you instantly until you have Maw. Also very strong early game.
| Counters your invisibility because she does constant damage over time and she is incredibly hard to stick on.
| If he gets ahead, he can burst you instantly until you have Maw. However, you beat him early and when you're even.
| Damage over time with Demonic Embrace shows where you are when invisible. Strong CC. He can also use your clone to land his Q. However, you can cancel his leap with your R and slap him early game.
| Beats you if he lands his abilities.
| Hard to get on and he has really good team-fight potential. Best bet is to play on the opposite side of him.

| Forces you to go out of your way to kill camps to deny her passive. Can kite you and stall with R. Lot's of damage even through Steelcaps and your passive. Try counter-ganking & invading in hopes to catch her without CDs up. Randuin's Omen is solid.
| Damage over time with Demonic Embrace and Despair shows where you are when invisible. Strong CC. However, he's very weak early game.
| You beat him early, but can't really kill him without CC from your team. Try to force fights before he transforms. If he gets a free early lead, you're screwed.
| Hard CC, but you can block her Q with clone. Try to counter gank, you're stronger when even on items.
| AP champ. Dumpsters you late game and when ahead. You are stronger early.
| Miasma and Ult is really annoying. Wait to engage after she's used them.
| Generally beat him in early skrimishes. Can outscale you.
| Scary early, easily dealt with late-game. Wait for him to jump into your team and slap him.
| Can be super scary if he gets free kills early and snowballs. Not a problem later because you one shot him in fights with your R up.
| Every divers worst nightmare. Shields, knock-back, knock-up, slows, yucky.
| Really hard to contest first Rift Herald without your ult. You also can't cancel her E unlike Master Yi meditate. Wukong also struggles to kill her due to her immense amount of dashes.
| Both lane and jungle Warwick are incredibly hard to kill early game. Just wait for him to fall off and you can dispatch him easily with Cyclone + Sunderer.
| Full clear champs are terrifying because counter-jungling is back in the meta as of patch 13.5. Ask laners for wards in your entrances and make sure to gank or you'll fall behind.
| Can be really scary when ahead because he ignores your ult and you have to be in his face to do damage.
